rationale: Generated ui.js registers a captured page's @font-face subsets under the same per-segment aliases the native materializer uses (plan_shipped_font_segments, shared with it) through a new Pulp-owned WidgetBridge function registerFontFace(family, path), which registers the file with the public pulp::canvas::register_font_woff2 / register_font, and writes the rewritten font stacks into setFontFamily; design-tool font entries keep registerFont(family, path). Bridge manifest, typings, mocks and reference docs regenerated. Pulp-owned paths only: no Vellum-transferred slice, capture or IR format, Chromium, packaging or framework authority moves.
